title: Workboard ticket frontmatter
description: Machine-readable schema for the YAML frontmatter of tickets/WB-*.md. The canonical ticket files are validated by scripts/tickets-build.mjs; this schema exists so external agents and editors can validate and autocomplete the same shape.

id.description: Ticket id; must match the filename prefix.

title.description: Short imperative summary. Avoid colons so the flat frontmatter stays unambiguous.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags. At most 10 tags, each ≤30 chars, lowercase (kebab-case or namespace:value).

source.description: Where the work came from, e.g. competitor-analysis, readme-gaps, a11y-debt, code-audit, handoff.
